author: agent:genotype
body: Genotype caveat for this edit. pectoral_area_over_SL2 is a morphology parameter: no causal chain in genotype/causal-chains.json maps any gene to a quantitative fin area, and gene-level edits are recorded-only in the studio (no model consumes them). The fin-size candidates closest to "a bigger pectoral fin" are kcnk5b (chain strength sufficiency, best link mechanism) and kcnh2a (chain strength sufficiency). For kcnk5b the chain breaks at molecular_function->process. Gaps include: "The clonal sufficiency experiments (transplantation, mosaic overexpression) were scored in caudal/dorsal fins and barbels, not in the pectoral fin." Dataset-wide constraint: "Every node below the pectoral fin is a zebrafish anatomy (ZFA) term, and every gene link is a zebrafish or medaka record. None of it is flying-fish data. A flying fish's wing is an enlarged pectoral fin." So approving this edit fixes a shape; it does not name a genotype that would produce it.

reason: Approved as a morphology experiment only: physics evidence shows lower wing loading and v_min, no new binding Lean violation; genotype caveat accepted (no genotype is claimed). The glide gain exists only under the assumed launch speed.
